Release Notes

ProDEPLOY is your tool to make deployments easier and faster. Software Applications and Configurations are listed on the Backoffice and made accessible with a simple 5 character code.

For B26 firmware, please ensure to first update ProDEPLOY by entering code 0 for AOSP and 1 for EDLA devices.

Application Deployment

Deploy your applications easier than ever

Simplicity is key
With a simple code, your applications are installed with a simple press of a button.

Sharing is caring
Share your applications with potential new users. This is also the place to ensure the latest version is always installed on a fresh device.

No more tapping through permission lists
ProDEPLOY can grant any permission the app requires, or customize it to your secure environments.

Device Configurations

Faster configuration and setup

Configure to your needs
Using the built-in StartupWizard* from ProDVX, you can configure your Android Device to your liking, including network settings, Device Owner options, Autostart, signage options and more!

No USB sticks or SD card that have to travel everywhere
Just input the code and you’re set!

Ensure to start ProDEPLOY from the Startup Wizard supplied on all ProDVX devices*

Deployment Packages (v1.1.0+)

One code to rule them all
Add applications and configurations together in one package, or just multiple applications. Do as you like!

The future
